findings.text: The fragment states 'the sibling cases read result.stdout', which is false at the reviewed head: tests/test_crew_shadow.py:504 (the --dry-run lineage case, read at ef21a4bf) still parses json.loads(result.output), and that case reads result.output rather than stdout, so the stated justification for the one-line change rests on a claim the file contradicts; the change itself is still correct, and only the reason given for it is overstated.

The done_when asks for the arm over the test files importing promotion_evidence recorded as inline JSON with full 40-character revisions, but baseline_suite and after_suite name tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py and tests/test_every_shared_home_lock_holds_across_nodes.py (58 passed, EXIT=0 at each revision), a selection that does not import the changed module; the importer arm itself exists only as arm-importers-base.log and arm-importers-head.log on disk (139 passed, 1 failed, the same KeyError id at each revision), so the pair the done_when names is not the reviewed change's arm and no inline JSON cites the arm that is.

The done_when requires the head run as a job on all_debug, but no recorded artefact names the partition: the gate log's header carries the revision, tree, command and the note that sbatch was invoked with the allocation id unset, and never the partition or the job id, so the venue rests on the manifest's prose at manifest.md:10 and on the submitting command in the run's stream rather than on a log a reader can open.

notes: Read at repo revision a559b64140ad57f15e6d075710965346f71775fe (this review worktree), which does not contain the reviewed head; every file of the reviewed diff was read through git show at 42fe90d0 and ef21a4bf. No added assertion compares a value against the value handed in: the only changed assertion parses result.stdout and feeds the persisted pointer, whose session and wave come from the CLI arguments. added_failure_count and added_failure_ids are derived from the reviewed run's own suite arms, baseline_suite-1795056759873944555.log (58 passed, EXIT=0 at 42fe90d0) and after_suite-1795056804707436747.log (58 passed, EXIT=0 at 985eec0f), each carrying a summary line so the zero is a measured clean pair, not an absent outcome.
